credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/holly.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. BRACED: crouched behind a spined shield leaf and a crest leaf, three berries at the chest. Gesture: the leaves hunch in, then flare with every spine bristling white-tipped, the berries glint, settle. Two hues: berry red in the dark slot (the berries); the leaves shade to black, not red (red shading read as variegation), with white midribs. Sport: 'Bacciflava' yellow-berried holly.
